A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LIFT research and contain 22 complete, readable pages, including Appendices A-K. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures without material gaps.

before.justification: v5 reports original LIFT experiments on SQuAD, NIAH, and LooGLE, alongside efficiency measurements and appendix experiments on capability retention, method variants, summarization, and skill acquisition.

after.justification: v6 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and all appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Sentence-based synthetic QA generation, LoRA fine-tuning, the supervised objective, asynchronous generation-training pipeline, and inference procedure are unchanged. The appendix method variants are also retained.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same SQuAD, NIAH, and LooGLE tasks. Appendices G and K retain MMLU, GSM8K, and ARC Challenge capability evaluations, GovReport summarization, and the GSM8K skill-acquisition scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: Figure 4 retains SEAL, MemoryLLM, and Finetune-Raw; Table 3 retains MemoryLLM, LlamaIndex, TempLoRA, LLMLingua, truncated ICL, and Finetune-Raw. Appendix D retains the LLoCO comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A-E retain the same backbone configurations, 8K context truncation, synthetic QA counts, training settings, GPT-4 judging, NIAH scoring procedure, and LLoCO train/test partition. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The failure-mode analysis and asynchronous-pipeline comparison are retained. Appendices G-J preserve the same capability-retention tests, LIFT variants, synthetic-data diversity analyses, and target-model-as-generator experiment.

E5.justification: Appendix G still reports averages over ten models adapted to different documents. Neither version reports seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests; statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical results and plotted findings match throughout. For example, Table 3 retains LIFT with 10QA scores of 52.69 on ShortQA and 27.25 on LongQA; Table 13 retains LIFT scores of 30.9 on GovReport and 65.4 on GSM8K.

T1.justification: Equation (1)'s synthetic-task loss and Section 3.3's O(m l^2) versus O(m^2 l^2) complexity argument are unchanged. No mathematical definition, assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The shortened abstract retains the same claims about storing context in parameters, improving comprehension through synthetic tasks, and achieving TTFT below ten seconds for 8K input. The introduction's contributions and conclusion's scientific claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the explanation that synthetic tasks improve local information coverage more than document-wide information association, including the LongQA limitation in Section 4.4 and the conclusion. Appendix interpretations and qualifications also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, hardware, generator prompts, evaluation prompts, and baseline reproduction details are unchanged. v6 prints the repository URL explicitly in the abstract, but v5's linked word 'here' already points to that same repository.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with retrieval, memory augmentation, test-time training, and synthetic-data approaches. The references merely reflow across pages.

P1.justification: v6 condenses the abstract, updates author affiliations and contribution markers, adds funding acknowledgments, changes several appendix references from 'Appendix' to 'Section', and updates publication text. These are limited editorial changes; the scientific narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: The proceedings notice and revised text produce limited spacing and page reflow, including moving the conclusion's opening from page 8 to page 9. Figures, tables, captions, and their contents are retained; appendix pages 14-22 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v6 provides a shorter abstract, updated author and publication information, and funding acknowledgments. The method, empirical evidence, reproducibility details, and substantive limitations remain unchanged, including all appendices. These limited editorial and formatting updates leave overall paper quality essentially equivalent.
